mapper.insert: INSERT INTO section_test_summary ( user_id, section_id,course_id, test_name, test_batch_no, total_questions, answered_questions, correct_questions, wrong_questions, unanswered_questions, total_score, accuracy_rate, avg_time_spent, total_time_spent, start_time, end_time, deadline, exam_duration, status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sectionId},#{courseId},#{testName}, #{testBatchNo}, #{totalQuestions}, #{answeredQuestions}, #{correctQuestions}, #{wrongQuestions}, #{unansweredQuestions}, #{totalScore}, #{accuracyRate}, #{avgTimeSpent}, #{totalTimeSpent}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{deadline}, #{examDuration}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE section_test_summary SET test_name = #{testName}, answered_questions = #{answeredQuestions}, course_id = #{courseId}, correct_questions = #{correctQuestions}, wrong_questions = #{wrongQuestions}, unanswered_questions = #{unansweredQuestions}, total_score = #{totalScore}, accuracy_rate = #{accuracyRate}, avg_time_spent = #{avgTimeSpent}, total_time_spent = #{totalTimeSpent}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND section_id = #{sectionId} AND test_batch_no = #{testBatchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM section_test_summary WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < NOW()
SELECT * FROM section_test_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'AUTO_SUBMITTED') ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT HOUR(start_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM section_test_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HOUR(start_time) ORDER BY hour
mapper.update: UPDATE section_test_summary SET status = 'AUTO_SUBMITTED', end_time = #{endTime}, total_time_spent = #{totalTimeSpent}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
